issues: The 'Order eSIM' and 'Order number' buttons are not level (about 13 px apart). The mobile card's note wraps to 2 lines and sits under the button while the ul is flex-1. Put the note above the button or give both notes a fixed min-height.

The new links (eSIM, US mobile number, Business calling, Pricing, Help) are at the very bottom of the menu, about 1350 px down, after the long Products and Use cases lists. Move them to the top, since the page now leads with these two products.
The floating support-chat button overlaps the right edge of the full-width 'Order eSIM' button when that button reaches the bottom of the screen.
